additions.name: Critical Weather sheltering at All Roads
additions.summary: Life-safety overnight shelter on forecast critical-weather nights; extra beds at All Roads. Beds are limited and not guaranteed.
additions.access: Arrive at All Roads before 7 PM. Must go through Coordinated Entry (a grace night is provided if CE is closed).
additions.hoursText: Activated on critical-weather nights; arrive before 7:00 PM
additions.eligibility: People experiencing homelessness screened through CE but not currently in a program; up to 90 critical-weather nights. Must be in good standing and follow shelter health and safety rules.
additions.fieldNotes: Criteria (NWS forecast): blizzard or wind warning with gusts >70 mph; OR predicted daytime low ≤20°F; OR ≥6 inches of snow. Don't promise a bed. Memo 03 notes about +20 beds and rec-center overflow when full (not on city page).
additions.sourceNote: Verified 2026-11-14: City "Where to Get Help" Critical Weather section (criteria, arrive before 7 PM, no bed guarantee, 90 nights, CE with grace night).

additions.name: City of Boulder Extreme Weather Shelter
additions.summary: Temporary 24-hour shelter the city may open during multi-night extreme cold. Location announced per activation.
additions.access: Watch City of Boulder news for activations; past activation used the Age Well wing of East Boulder Community Center, 5660 Sioux Dr.
additions.hoursText: Only when activated (decided ≥48 hours ahead from NWS forecasts)
additions.fieldNotes: Opens only when conditions are expected for ≥3 nights AND either a daily high ≤5°F with heavy precipitation/blizzard/heavy wind (30 mph sustained / 70 mph gusts) or a winter-weather watch/warning, OR a nightly low ≤0°F — and only if the city has resources. Location varies by activation.
additions.sourceNote: Verified 2026-11-14: City "Where to Get Help" Extreme Weather Shelter criteria; city news post https://bouldercolorado.gov/news/city-and-partners-open-extreme-weather-shelter (Jan 18–21 activation at East Boulder Community Center).

corrections.reason: CARE and CIRT ended in 2025 and were replaced by BHCR; record still uses the old program names. City page confirms request route, program line and that response depends on program hours and staffing.
